remarks: Rare opportunity in Stamford's desirable Shippan neighborhood! This spacious 4-bedroom, 2-bath home offers over 2,500 sq ft of living space - providing incredible flexibility for homeowners. Currently configured as a single-family residence, the home features a welcoming foyer, large living room with fireplace, generous bedrooms, and a functional layout ideal for multi-generational living. Recent updates include a brand new roof, large detached garage with heat, water and electricity, private driveway, and additional storage shed. Located minutes from Shippan beaches, downtown Stamford, Metro-North, shopping, dining, and major highways, this property offers the perfect combination of space, location, and investment potential. An exceptional value for a property of this size and versatility in Stamford. Must See!
